name: kktestdev-pack
policy: Never pin versions: plugins follow their marketplace, npm packages use @latest. /kk-update refreshes everything.
keys: Read by inventory.mjs: items[].id/profile/kind/detect/requires/what, overlapGroups. Read by the skills only: marketplaces, items[].plugin/steps/windows/scope/doc/publisher. detect keys: plugins (id prefix), mcpName (whole-token match at start or end of the server name), mcpNameExact, mcpUrl (substring), mcpCommand (binary name), mcpArgs (package or path segment), skills (exact name).
windowsNote: On native Windows, npx and npm-installed bins are .cmd shims: stdio MCP servers must be registered through cmd /c. Each mcp item has a `windows` variant of its steps.

items.what: Workflow skills: brainstorm, plan, TDD, systematic debugging, code review, verification before completion.
Everyday discipline: additive changes, no duplicate docs, proactive reminders, Conventional Commits.

items.publisher: Upstash; queries go to the hosted service mcp.context7.com
items.what: Current library documentation lookup (Next.js, React, NestJS, Spring, ...) instead of the model's memory.

TS/JS code intelligence (go-to-definition, references, diagnostics). typescript-language-server uses the workspace's own typescript (node_modules/typescript, which provides tsserver), so each project needs typescript as a devDependency. typescript 7 (native) ships no tsserver; the server then has nothing to load. Needs Node 22.22.2+.
Python type checking and code intelligence.

requires.install: macOS/Linuxbrew: brew install jdtls. Otherwise download a milestone build from https://github.com/eclipse-jdtls/eclipse.jdt.ls, unpack it, and put its bin/ (jdtls, jdtls.bat; needs Java 21+ and Python 3) on PATH

steps: claude mcp add --scope user bantamkit -- bantamkit-mcp
windows: claude mcp add --scope user bantamkit -- cmd /c bantamkit-mcp
items.what: Cross-session memory (recall/save), token ledger, skill audit. Works alongside Claude's own auto-memory. Hooks are opt-in: see docs/bantamkit-hooks.md.

steps: claude mcp add --scope user playwright -- npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest --headless
windows: claude mcp add --scope user playwright -- cmd /c npx -y @playwright/mcp@latest --headless
items.what: Browser automation and E2E checks (cross-browser, headless).

steps: claude mcp add --scope user chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest
windows: claude mcp add --scope user chrome-devtools -- cmd /c npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest
items.what: Chrome performance traces, Lighthouse, network/console debugging.
Frontend design quality: build, critique and audit UI.

steps: claude mcp add --scope user next-devtools -- npx -y next-devtools-mcp@latest
windows: claude mcp add --scope user next-devtools -- cmd /c npx -y next-devtools-mcp@latest
items.what: Talks to a running Next.js 16+ dev server: routes, build/runtime errors, docs.

steps: (inside the project) npx shadcn@latest mcp init --client claude
windows: (inside the project) npx shadcn@latest mcp init --client claude, then check .mcp.json: if the shadcn server's command is npx, change it to command cmd with args ["/c", "npx", ...]
items.what: Browse and add shadcn/ui components. Writes the project's .mcp.json, so run it per project.
Read Sentry issues, events and stack traces (OAuth to your own Sentry account).
Query Prometheus/Loki, dashboards, alerts (needs a Grafana service-account token).

items.publisher: Oraios (community-managed entry in the official catalog)
items.what: Semantic code navigation for large codebases (symbol-level find/refactor).

items.publisher: Server/DC: sooperset/mcp-atlassian (community, PyPI via uvx); Cloud: Atlassian
items.what: Not installed by the pack: each person connects with their own credentials (LDAP).
Not installed by the pack: each person connects their own Figma account.

overlapGroups.label: Browser automation
overlapGroups.note: Playwright: scripted, cross-browser, E2E. chrome-devtools: perf traces, Lighthouse, live debugging. Claude in Chrome (built into Claude Code; this scan cannot see it): drives your real logged-in browser. More of these means more tool descriptions loaded in every session.

overlapGroups.label: Code review
overlapGroups.note: Claude Code ships /code-review. superpowers has requesting-code-review. Extra review plugins add different reviewers (external services or specialised agents), at the cost of more skills/agents in context.

overlapGroups.label: Commit / PR workflow
overlapGroups.note: kkskills-essentials gives the message convention; commit-commands gives one-shot commit/push/PR commands. They overlap on commit messages, not on automation.

overlapGroups.label: Planning / orchestration
overlapGroups.note: Two planning skill sets can both trigger on the same request and give different procedures.

overlapGroups.label: Frontend design
overlapGroups.note: Both steer UI generation. With both enabled the guidance can conflict.

overlapGroups.label: Memory
overlapGroups.note: Claude's auto-memory is always on unless disabled. bantamkit syncs with it (exports its project facts into MEMORY.md and mirrors new auto-memory files). Other memory tools usually do not sync.

overlapGroups.label: Security review
overlapGroups.note: Claude Code ships /security-review (on demand). Plugins here add edit-time warnings or external scanners.

overlapGroups.label: TypeScript language server
overlapGroups.note: Two TS language servers index the same files twice.

optionsNote: items[].options holds identity hints only (npm package, binary, env-var prefix) so options.mjs can find the INSTALLED version's own --help and docs; the option list itself is never stored here.
